stories.headline: OpenAI resumes training after security overhaul
stories.summary: OpenAI resumed frontier-model training after barring internet access and strengthening containment. External evaluators found monitoring gaps; OpenAI says it patched them, but the evaluators have not verified the fixes.

stories.headline: Moonshot curbs hacking ability in new Kimi model
stories.summary: Moonshot removed cyber data from Kimi K3.1 Pro training before releasing open weights. Its internal test showed lower offensive performance than an unfiltered version, but the benchmark has not been independently verified.

stories.headline: Pentagon targets Confucius Institutes
stories.summary: The Pentagon designated Chinese-funded campus centers a national-security threat. Defense Secretary Hegseth alleged 80 rebranded groups operated at 30 universities; China had not responded to Reuters.

stories.headline: Russia and Ukraine agree local ceasefire
stories.summary: Both sides agreed to halt fighting in Oleshky from October 27 for aid and evacuations and plan technical peace talks next month. Wider territorial and security disputes remain unresolved.

stories.headline: Hormuz ship attacks hit record monthly high
stories.summary: A research tally counted 28 confirmed or reported attacks in October, the highest monthly total since tracking began in 2017. UK authorities caution that incomplete voluntary reports may understate the true number.
